resolved_findings.title: Final startup query failure leaked the browser child and temporary profile
resolved_findings.trigger: The first Browser.getVersion and Extensions.loadUnpacked succeed; the final Browser.getVersion rejects before a session handle is returned.
resolved_findings.red_observation: The synthetic pipe child was still alive after launch rejected: expected false, actual true; test exit 1. Cleanup from t.after killed only that synthetic child.
resolved_findings.fix: Moved the final version query into the existing startup try/catch so failure invokes close before rejection.
resolved_findings.green_observation: Child was no longer alive and its temporary profile was absent when launch rejected; focused exit 0 and full scoped suite exit 0.

resolved_findings.title: Forced real-host mode skipped its availability check
resolved_findings.trigger: installHost({mode:"real"}) is called with an isolated SOLTUI_REPO containing no native host.
resolved_findings.red_observation: The call resolved instead of the documented rejection; Missing expected rejection, test exit 1. No real host process was invoked.
resolved_findings.fix: Removed the mode==real short circuit; every non-fixture selection uses the availability predicate, and explicit real mode refuses its false result.
resolved_findings.green_observation: The call rejected with the host readiness error and no profile installation was written; focused exit 0 and full scoped suite exit 0.
